topic: A thunderstorm night: Mishi is scared of the loud thunder and Bruno stays beside her with a blanket fort.

episode.title: Mishi & Bruno: The Cozy Thunder Fort

shots.narration: Could a blanket turn this rumbly night into something cozy?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, warm 3D animated living room, rain streaking a dark window, folded blankets beside rounded sofa cushions, no text.
shots.action: Mishi hugs a yellow cushion while Bruno sits nearby.
shots.mood: Soft amber lamplight, Mishi's ears slightly lowered, gentle rainy-night atmosphe

shots.scene: Warm living room rug beside the sofa, rainy window in the background.
shots.mood: Reassuring closeness, soft rounded shapes, warm golden light.

shots.narration: [whispers] Mishi had a clever, cozy idea.
shots.scene: Living room rug with two broad sofa cushions and a folded blue blanket.
shots.mood: Mishi's bright green eyes widen with inspiration, Bruno watches attentively.

shots.narration: Bruno nudged the first cushion into place.
shots.scene: Soft living room rug beneath the rounded sofa edge.
shots.action: Bruno pushes a broad cushion onto its flat base with his nose.
shots.mood: Playful concentration, Bruno's floppy ears hanging beside his cheeks.

shots.narration: Mishi carefully placed another cushion beside it.
shots.scene: Living room rug, first cushion standing low and stable.
shots.action: Mishi positions a second broad cushion a kitten-width from the first.
shots.mood: Careful teamwork, rich cushion colours, soft warm shadows.

shots.narration: [chuckles] Bruno added a wonderfully wobbly blanket roof.
shots.scene: Two low cushion supports on the living room rug, lightweight blue blanket.
shots.action: Bruno drapes the blanket across both cushions.
shots.mood: A charming uneven blanket roof, Bruno's proud smile, Mishi's amused eyes.

shots.narration: Mishi opened their tiny front door.
shots.scene: Low blue blanket fort with an open front and yellow cushion floor.
shots.action: Mishi lifts one corner of the blanket.
shots.mood: Inviting golden glow, soft fabric folds, a snug little hideaway.

shots.narration: Bruno squeezed inside, floppy ears first.
shots.scene: Blanket fort entrance on the soft rug, Mishi holding the flap.
shots.action: Bruno crawls through the wide fort entrance.
shots.mood: Gentle silliness, Bruno's ears brushing the soft blanket edge.

shots.narration: [sighs] The thunder still rumbled, but Mishi wasn't alone.
shots.scene: Inside the open-front blanket fort, distant rainy window beyond.
shots.mood: Mishi's ears relaxed, Bruno's calm smile, warm light across fluffy fur.

shots.narration: Bruno tucked a little blanket around them both.
shots.scene: Cosy fort interior with yellow cushion flooring and a small peach blanket.
shots.action: Bruno draws the peach blanket across their paws.
shots.mood: Tender friendship, loose comfortable blanket folds, sleepy contented faces.

shots.narration: Their little boat could explore tomorrow's garden puddles.
shots.scene: Open fort entrance, small plain wooden toy boat within Mishi's reach.
shots.action: Mishi places the toy boat beside the entrance.
shots.mood: Quiet anticipation, rain droplets shining softly on the distant window.

shots.narration: [whispers] Friends bring comfort; tomorrow, we're sailing puddles!
shots.scene: Wide vertical view of the warm living room, blanket fort and wooden toy boat in the foreground.
shots.action: Mishi rests one paw on Bruno's foreleg.
shots.mood: Peaceful smiles beneath the blue blanket roof, gentle rain outside, cosy amber l

episode.endHook: Tomorrow, a little boat sets sail in garden puddles!
episode.description: A rumbly night feels much cozier when Bruno stays beside Mishi. Together, they build a blanket fort and discover the comfort of a caring friend.
